description_zh: 调用该接口更新时间模板
kebab_example: aliyun linkvisual update-time-template --time-sections DayOfWeek=0 Begin=20000 End=60000 --template-id fc82774fa749485bad7d719f96700000 --name test --all-day 0 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateTimeTemplate

element_fields.help_en: The day of the week. Valid values: 0 to 6, which represent Sunday through Saturday
element_fields.help_zh: 每周的周几，取值范围0~6，表示周日~周六
element_fields.name: day_of_week

element_fields.help_en: The start time of each day. Valid values: 0 to 86399. Unit: seconds
element_fields.help_zh: 每天开始的时间，取值范围0~86399，单位为秒
element_fields.name: begin

element_fields.help_en: The end time of each day. Valid values: 1 to 86399. Unit: seconds
element_fields.help_zh: 每天结束的时间，取值范围1~86399，单位为秒
element_fields.name: end

parameters.help_en: The ID of the time template. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/107890.html to query the ID
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the time template.

The name must be fewer than 48 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and the following special characters: hyphens (-), underscores (_), at signs (@), periods (.), and colons (:)
parameters.help_zh:
时间模板名称。

名称长度小于48个字符，可以包含英文字母、数字和特殊字符：短划线（-）、下划线（_）、at（@）、英文句号（.）、英文冒号（:）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable 24/7 recording. Valid values:

- 1: Yes.
- 0: No. For detailed configurations, see the TimeSections.N.DayOfWeek, TimeSections.N.Begin, and TimeSections.N.End parameters
parameters.help_zh:
是否7天*24小时录像：

- 1：是。
- 0：否，详细配置请查看TimeSections.N.DayOfWeek、TimeSections.N.Begin和TimeSections.N.End参数
parameters.name: all_day
